name: Drowned Drover
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Marked as Driven Stock
Traits.text: When the drover hits a creature with Iron-Shod Crook, the target is marked as driven stock until the end of the drover's next turn; while marked, the drover's allies have Advantage on attack rolls against it and the drover knows the direction and distance to it.
Traits.clause: Whenever the drover hits a creature with Iron-Shod Crook, the target is marked as driven stock until the end of the drov
Traits.expresses: never fighting alone — the herd takes the blows
Traits.expressedQuote: the drover's allies have Advantage on attack rolls against it

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the drover, the drover and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the drover doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The drover makes three attacks, using Iron-Shod Crook or Herding Blow in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Drive the Herd.

Actions.name: Iron-Shod Crook
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 14 (3d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Herding Blow
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 21 (5d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Drive the Herd
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the drover and has the Prone condition.

lore: A drover who drowned with his stable in the great fen-flood, the Shepherd wades the drowned pastures, gathering drowned beasts into a herd and driving them at any living thing that crosses the water.

unplaced.text: The drover has Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, and its attacks with Iron-Shod Crook and Herding Blow deal an extra {dmg} Necrotic damage.

generation.userConcept: a shepherd of drowned horses who never fights alone
answered_by_existing: never fights alone -> Aura of Authority
